preconditions.description: The length of the string n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of kinds of pairs of brackets k is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= abs(s_i) <= k for s_i in s)
preconditions.description: Each bracket in the string s is an integer with absolute value between 1 and k inclusive.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all((query[0] == 1 and 1 <= query[1] <= n and 1 <= abs(query[2]) <= k) or (query[0] == 2 and 1 <= query[1] <= query[2] <= n) for query in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query is either of type 1 with valid position and bracket type, or of type 2 with valid substring range.

postconditions.expression: all((query[0] == 1 and isinstance(query[2], int)) or (query[0] == 2 and isinstance(query[1], int) and isinstance(query[2], int)) for query in queries)
postconditions.description: Each query is correctly formatted with integer values for positions and bracket types.

postconditions.expression: all((query[0] == 2 and (stdout[i] == 'Yes' or stdout[i] == 'No')) for i, query in enumerate(queries) if query[0] == 2)
postconditions.description: For each query of type 2, the output is either 'Yes' or 'No'.
